statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-quotient-pre-equivalence-relation-restrict (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4035-4050

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: two sections of U'/R' mapping equal in U/R become pairs a_i, a_i' over a tau-covering; the pointwise description of quotient sheaves (045Y) refines the covering so that a relation r_i in R between g a_i and g a_i' exists; since R' is the fibre product of R with U' x U' over U x U, the pair (r_i, (a_i, a_i')) is a section of R' witnessing the equivalence, so xi = xi' by the sheaf condition; surjectivity holds when g induces a sheaf surjection, in particular when g is a covering (00WT) (source lines 4052-4075)

standard_prerequisites.name: Lemma lemma-quotient-pre-equivalence (canonical tag 045Y)
standard_prerequisites.use: Pointwise description of the quotient sheaf.

core_obligations: Injectivity (proof lines 4054-4070): after a tau-covering refinement the two sections are classes of a_i, a_i' in U'(T_i); 045Y refines so g a_i = s r_i and g a_i' = t r_i; the fibre-product description of R' makes (r_i, (a_i, a_i')) a section of R'(T_i), so a_i ~ a_i' in U'/R'(T_i); the sheaf condition gives xi = xi'.
Surjectivity (proof lines 4072-4075): h_{U'} -> h_U surjective implies U'/R' -> U/R surjective; {g} a tau-covering gives the sheaf surjection by 00WT.
proof_roadmap: Prove injectivity by refining coverings and using the fibre-product description of R' (proof lines 4054-4070).
Conclude surjectivity under the sheaf-surjection hypothesis (proof lines 4072-4075).
